summary: Before: the login card and workspace already used a sage-green palette, but modals (Memory & skills, Routines) used default system sans, mismatched button sizes, plain-text status and equal-weight outlined actions; the sidebar had spaced all-caps labels, boxed Connections/File library buttons and a three-icon owner footer that overlapped text at tablet width; the Work panel's removed-work row collapsed into a one-word-per-line column and file sizes showed '0.0 KB'. Refined: introduced a geometric sans (DM Sans-like), sentence-case section labels, a single Owner chevron menu, a status-pill Routines card with a text-style action row and a filled Run now, and added 320 and 844x390 captures to test small viewports. After: added the Owner popover (Connections, File library, Workspace settings, theme toggle, Sign out), a scrollable sidebar with pinned Routines/Owner footer, new Connections, File library, Create group/teammate and Workspace settings modals, a dark theme, accurate byte sizes, a fixed removed-work row and softer link-style work actions. Remaining visible issues: the Create teammate colour input renders as a thin line, 'Curated memory' stays a bare heading, and Memory modal buttons stay uneven. Landscape 844x390 modals still clip, and some fixture data (Phase 4 UI fixtures) appears in screenshots.
